disclaimer: Fixture-contract evidence. Every number below describes the agent's control plane — stop decisions, budgets, citation resolution, traces, determinism — measured against a deterministic in-process retrieval fixture over a small committed corpus. It is not a measurement of retrieval quality, answer quality, faithfulness, latency or production readiness, and no number here supports a comparison with any other system.

invariants.description: Steps taken never exceed the budget the case set, and the trace agrees.
Every run ends terminal, with a closed-set reason and a report.
The trace opens with a plan, pairs calls with results, and ends with stop.
A capped, non-empty plan is recorded before any tool runs.
Every printed marker resolves, in order, to a passage that was retrieved.
No cited chunk id or source path comes from outside the corpus.
A chunk returned by two steps is stored, and cited, once.
An answer carries citations; a run with no evidence refuses.
Every retrieval was served by the backend the runner bound.
Every gap the critic named appears in the report.
Repeating the whole evaluation produces byte-identical case records.
Cases differing only in surface form produce the same outcome and evidence.
